usage: The standard birthday wish, understood everywhere. Iraqis add the general blessing "kull sana w-inta saalim" and wish the person a long life.

variants.label: blessing
variants.english: every year and you are well
variants.note: Used for birthdays and any yearly occasion; to a woman "w-inti saalma".

variants.label: long life
variants.note: A warm, slightly playful wish for a long life.

responses.english: thanks, and may you be well

examples.arabic: كُل سَنة وإنتِ سالمة، عُقبال المِيّة
examples.english: Many happy returns, may you reach a hundred
I bought you a gift for your birthday
